claims.text: HEBM followed by rapid, low-dwell SPS will suppress porosity in CoCrFeNiTi.
SPS at approximately 900–1000 K will kinetically trap a nanocrystalline FCC solid solution with minor BCC in CoCrFeNiTi.
The 900–1000 K range is just above an FCC–BCC transition threshold for CoCrFeNiTi.
Rapid heating and short dwell will avoid brittle HCP formation.
Short thermal exposure will suppress Cr-rich precipitation that otherwise occurs during prolonged exposure.
HEBM produces CoCrFeNiTi powder having high oxygen content.
HEBM produces a nanocrystalline powder structure.
Ti content gives the milled CoCrFeNiTi powder a potential to form HCP.
A heating rate above 100 K/min and dwell below 5 minutes will minimize diffusion-driven phase separation.
Vacuum or inert-gas SPS will prevent oxidation of the powder.
Strain rates during SPS are driven by rapid thermal expansion and pressure application.
Milling defects and residual strain pin grain boundaries and promote retention of fine grains.
FCC is entropically stabilized relative to HCP at elevated temperature.
Rapid sintering prevents the grain growth associated with longer thermal processing.
The processed alloy will have significantly greater hardness than the conventionally cast material because of grain refinement.
The proposed processing route will avoid brittleness associated with HCP or excessive Laves-phase precipitation.
The hypothesis requires a temperature below approximately 633 K because HCP becomes thermodynamically dominant above that threshold.
Cr/V segregation or Laves precipitation typically requires approximately 1000 hours at 700 °C or another prolonged exposure.
Vickers microhardness can be measured at a 1.96 N load and 15 s dwell.
Nanoindentation load–displacement curves and a grain-size correlation can separate grain-refinement strengthening from solute strengthening.

contradictions.description: The proposed SPS window is 900–1000 K, but the boundary says the hypothesis holds only below approximately 633 K. The stated operating regime therefore lies outside its own asserted validity boundary.
The intervention requires a dwell time below 5 minutes, whereas the experiment specifies a dwell of exactly 5 minutes.

The mechanism invokes high-temperature stabilization of FCC over HCP, while the boundary states that HCP becomes thermodynamically dominant above approximately 633 K. These describe opposite temperature dependence.
